create_dvmark_encoder: create a DVMarkEncoder module to embed watermark bits into video frames using 3D convolutional layers
create_dvmark_decoder: create a DVMarkDecoder module to extract watermark bits from watermarked video frames
build_watermark_pipeline: build a video watermarking pipeline using DVMarkEncoder to embed messages and DVMarkDecoder to extract them
test_encoder_forward: test the DVMarkEncoder forward pass with video tensors and message bit tensors
test_decoder_forward: test the DVMarkDecoder forward pass with watermarked video tensors to recover embedded messages
